meta.method: Parallel web search (rate-limited free tier) + WebSearch + direct curl of: ihaleilanlar.com authority/contractor pages (EKAP sonuç ilanı aggregates), Rekabet Kurumu decisions, Bahrain Tender Board monthly 'Awarded Tenders' PDFs (11 months 2024-2026), NSF/ANSI-60 Saudi listing, company sites, chamber/directory listings (LABSIAD, Kuwait Industries Union, ABC-GCC, DCCI, Welipro, Telecontact, GoAfrica, TheOmanToday). No logins, no captcha bypass, nobody contacted.
meta.verification_rule: verified=true only when BOTH e-mail and phone appear in >=2 independent sources (own site + directory/chamber/tender notice/LinkedIn). verified_email / verified_phone flag partial confirmation. Two pages of the same company site or a company-authored exhibitor profile count as ONE source.
